content: Increment A mock-validation gate DISAGREE. The observed ManifestMock run has 8 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, but seven behavior cases use an in-test reference function; the eighth checks only the assertion oracle. Seven of eight real-target cases fail because lib/process-context.ps1 is absent; the remaining case is only an assertion-oracle check. More importantly, the real call has no resolver/policy callbacks for the case data, so the current mock cases cannot connect to production unchanged. The MCP TEST-PROCESS-002 PolicyMock command selects zero tests and reports Passed, a false-green risk. FR-PROCESS-001 revision pinning and genuinely different process graph are absent; exact-policy source/snapshot cases are incomplete. No production edit is authorized by this gate. Repair the fixture, run nonzero selected mock tests with negative controls, capture behavioral real-red, then repeat independent hostile review.

failures.remediation: Test exact ID/version/scope/digest/source/snapshot against injected fetch responses, including unapproved source and missing/duplicate policy; add a real MCP snapshot retrieval test before slice A exit.
